description: Test suite for MacNodeBrowserProxy, focusing on network request handling, response wrapping, and serialization, including regression tests for nested POST bodies.

classes.name: BodyCapture
classes.description: Actor class to asynchronously capture and retrieve HTTP request body data during tests.

methods.name: `request uses browser control endpoint and wraps result`
methods.description: Asynchronous test method verifying that the proxy correctly performs a GET request and wraps the JSON response, including parsing and validation.

methods.name: postRequestSerializesNestedBodyWithoutCrash
